author: bardic-inspiration
name: Crown of Borrowed Thought
summary: A crown that lets you read minds and overwhelm a mind in turn.
description: No one agrees who first wore it, only that none could wear it long. The metal is cold and slightly damp.

stats.effect: The crown has 6 charges. While you wear it, you can expend 1 charge as a Magic action to cast *Detect Thoughts* from it, or 3 charges to cast *Dominate Person* from it. The crown regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1, the crown turns to silver dust.
